title: Explore the recorded Agent research
intro: Recorded research only. No live Agent response, new analysis or ranking recalculation.
scope: Research guide language only. The rest of the application stays in English.
source: Original source text — not translated or read aloud
why: Why did this instrument stand out?
evidence: What evidence supports the recorded analysis?
abstain: Why did the explanation abstain, if applicable?
abstained: The explanation abstained. Individual verified claims do not establish a supported overall explanation.
noAbstention: This explanation is not recorded as abstained.
noReason: No failed-check details were supplied. Consult the original summary for any recorded reason; do not infer one from the score or research tier.
synthetic: Synthetic demonstration: claim statuses, checks and hashes are generated test records, not independently verified market events or query results.
temporal: This check asks whether the cause preceded the market move. Event and market-move timestamps are not supplied in this record, so the temporal comparison cannot be independently reproduced. The decision date and run creation time are not substitutes.
inspect: Inspect the full original claims, checks and evidence below
meaning: Tier, claim status and explanation verdict are separate recorded fields. None establishes investment performance or an instruction to trade.
voiceMissing: No suitable voice is available for this language. Refresh voices or choose another guide language explicitly; no language is substituted automatically.
unsupported: Read aloud is unavailable in this browser. All content remains readable.
privacy: Uses browser speech synthesis. The app sends no text to a translation or speech service. Some browser voices may use online services; offline speech is not guaranteed.
speechScope: Reads the structured answers in this guide. Original source narratives remain readable in their original language and are not spoken.
error: Speech could not continue. Check the selected voice and try again; the text remains available.
noExplanation: No explanation was supplied for this instrument.
